archetypes.name: Pride of the Legion
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Veteran Squads and Terminator Squads (Saturnine, Cataphractii and Indomitus) can be taken as Troops.
- Only a single Heavy Support choice and a single Fast Attack choice can be taken.
- The army cannot include more units that are not Infantry than units that are Infantry.
- The army cannot include an Allied Detachment or Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Armoured Spearhead
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Predators can be taken as Troops.
- Legion Sicaran Battle Tanks can be taken as Elites.
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Land Raider Carrier instead if it has ten models or fewer.
- Infantry units must start the game as passengers inside a transport.

archetypes.name: Drop Pod Assault (HH)
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino or a Land Raider Carrier may take a Legion Drop Pod instead.
- A unit with a Legion Drop Pod must arrive by Deep Strike.
- Units without a Drop Pod must start the game in Reserve and cannot arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Recon Demi-Company
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Scout Squads and Seeker Squads can be taken as Troops.
- All compulsory Troops selections must be Legion Scout Squads.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Angel's Wrath
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Caestus Assault Ram instead.
- A Flyer transport in reserve may enter automatically in the first battle round.
- Infantry units without jump packs must start the game as passengers inside a Flyer transport.
- Infantry units with jump packs must start the game in Reserve (they can arrive by Deep Strike).
- The army cannot include vehicles without the Flyer type, and cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Sky-hunter Phalanx
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Sky-hunter Squadrons and Land Speeder Squadrons can be taken as Troops.
- Vehicles in the army must be Fast, Skimmers or Flyers.
- Infantry units must start the game as passengers inside a Flyer transport.
- The army cannot include Dreadnoughts, Fortifications or an Allied Detachment.

archetypes.name: Underworld Assault
archetypes.desc:
- A unit that could take a Legion Rhino may take a Legion Termite instead.
- Legion Termites can be taken as Fast Attack and Heavy Support choices.
- Infantry units without the Massive(X) ability must start the game as passengers inside a Legion Termite.
- Units that are not Legion Termites or passengers in one cannot start in Reserve and cannot arrive by Deep Strike or Outflank.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Fury of the Ancients
archetypes.desc:
- Legion Contemptor Dreadnoughts can be taken as Troops, and all of the army's Troops selections must be Contemptor Dreadnoughts.
- Only a single Fast Attack choice and a single Heavy Support choice that is not made of Dreadnoughts can be taken.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.

archetypes.name: Deathwing Conclave (The Unbroken Vow)
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lion.
- Legion Veteran Squads and Terminator Squads can be taken as Troops.
- At least 25% of the army's Troops selections must be Legion Veteran Squads or Terminator Squads.
- Every unit gains Regeneration(1) while within 6" of a mission objective.
- The army cannot take Allied Detachments.
- Source: the 1st and 2nd edition Horus Heresy rules (the 3rd edition does not list what this Detachment restricts).

archetypes.name: The Steel Fist
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lion.
- Legion Predators can be taken as Troops and Legion Kratos Assault Tanks as Elites.
- Infantry units must start the game as passengers inside a transport that is not a Flyer.
- No unit can arrive by Deep strike or Outflank.

archetypes.name: The Storm of War
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lion.
- Legion Tactical, Despoiler and Assault Squads can be taken as Elites, and Legion Assault Squads as Fast Attack.
- Troops selections must take the maximum number of models.
- Tactical and Despoiler Squads cannot take a Dedicated Transport.
- No unit can arrive by Deep strike or Outflank.

archetypes.name: The Seeker's Arrow
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lion.
- Legion Sky-hunter and Outrider Squadrons can be taken as Troops.
- Troops and Fast Attack selections gain the Outflank ability.
- Vehicles must be Fast, Skimmers or Flyers, and only a single Heavy Support choice can be taken.

archetypes.name: The Serpent's Bane
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lion.
- Legion Seeker Squads can be taken as Troops, and all Troops selections must be Seeker Squads.
- Up to three Troops units gain the Infiltrator ability.

archetypes.name: Chogorian Brotherhood
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Great Khan.
- Legion Sky-hunter Squadrons and Outrider Squadrons can be taken as Troops.

archetypes.name: The Bloodied Claw
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Wolf King.
- Once per battle, at the start of a battle round, all units gain until the end of that round: +1 to combat resolution, the Furious charge ability, and they ignore negative Leadership modifiers.
- In that round every unit that can charge must charge an enemy unit it can reach.

archetypes.name: The Stone Gauntlet
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Praetorian of Terra.
- Only Legion Breacher Squads can be taken as Troops.

archetypes.name: Hammerfall Strike Force
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Praetorian of Terra.
- Any Infantry unit can gain the Deep strike ability for +1 point per Wound.
- Vehicles start the game in reserve and cannot arrive by Deep strike or Outflank.
- No Fortifications.

archetypes.name: The Day of Revelation
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Angel.
- Before the battle choose battle round 2, 3 or 4: every unit with the Deep strike ability arrives automatically at the start of that round.
- Units deployed on the battlefield are Fearless until the end of battle round 1.
- The Compulsory HQ must have a Jump pack. No Fortifications and no units that cannot move.

archetypes.name: The Head of the Gorgon
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Gorgon.
- Infantry units ignore negative Leadership modifiers while within their own deployment zone.
- Vehicles gain the Outflank ability.
- Only a single Fast Attack choice can be taken.

archetypes.name: Logos Lectora
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Avenging Son.
- Units cannot be set up as Infiltrators or arrive by Deep Strike.
- At the start of each battle round, choose one command that applies to all Infantry units until the end of the round. The same command cannot be chosen twice in a row.
- Full March: +2" Movement, -1 Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill.
- Hold Fast: +1 Leadership and re-roll failed to-hit rolls when shooting, but the units cannot be given an Advance order.
- Retribution Strike: +1 Weapon Skill and +1 to charge rolls, -1 Ballistic Skill.
- Regroup: re-roll failed Leadership tests to rally.

archetypes.name: The Covenant of Fire
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lord of Drakes.
- Legion Tactical Support Squads armed with Dragon's breath weapons can be taken as Troops.
- No unit can arrive by Deep strike.
- The army must include a Centurion with the Champion Consul.

archetypes.name: The Awakening Fire
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Lord of Drakes.
- Infantry units can gain the Terrifying(-1) ability for +1 point per model.
- Infantry units ignore negative Leadership modifiers.
- The army gets one extra HQ choice, which must be a Centurion with the Chaplain Consul, and must include one.

archetypes.name: Decapitation Strike
archetypes.desc:
- Can only be selected with the Legacy of the Liberator.
- Only one Heavy Support unit can be taken.
- The army cannot take Fortifications.
- Units that arrive by Deep Strike gain Light Cover until the end of that battle round.

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lion
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Dark Angels Armory.
- Any Character model may swap its Power sword for a Calibanite warblade for +1 point.
Legion: Dark Angels (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Great Khan
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the White Scars Armory.
- Any Character model may swap its Power sword for a Power glaive for +1 point.
Legion: White Scars (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Wolf King
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Space Wolves Armory.
- Any model in a Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad may swap their Power sword for a Frost sword, Frost axe or Frost claw for +1 point each.
- Any model with an Astartes chainsword may swap it for a Fenrisian axe for +1 point each.
Legion: Space Wolves (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Praetorian of Terra
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Imperial Fists Armory.
Legion: Imperial Fists (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Angel
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Blood Angels Armory.
- Any model with a Plasma pistol may swap it for an Inferno pistol for +0 points.
Legion: Blood Angels (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Gorgon
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Iron Hands Armory.
Legion: Iron Hands (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Avenging Son
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Ultramarines Armory.
Legion: Ultramarines (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Lord of Drakes
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Salamanders Armory.
- Any model with a Hand flamer may swap it for a Dragon's breath pistol for +4 points each.
Legion: Salamanders (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Liberator
legacies.desc:
The army has access to the Raven Guard Armory.
- Any model with a Lightning claw may swap it for a Raven's talons for +5 points each.
Legion: Raven Guard (Loyalist).

legacies.name: Legacy of the Sundered
legacies.desc:
The army has access to one Legion-specific unit or Consul type per 1000 points of game size.
Armory: only the general Armory (the Blackshields have no Legion Armory of their own).

traits.name: Grim Resolve
traits.desc: The unit does not suffer the to hit penalty from Defensive Fire.

traits.name: Scions of the Hexagrammaton
traits.desc:
Select one improvement that must be applied to any unit:
- Deathwing: The unit's melee attacks with Astartes chainswords, Force swords, Power swords, Terranic greatswords, Calibanite warblades and Paragon blades re-roll to hit rolls of 1.
- Dreadwing: The unit gains the "Move through cover" ability.
- Ironwing: The unit's ranged attacks against the vehicles and monstrous creatures re-roll to hit rolls of 1.
- Firewing: The unit's melee attacks against Characters and its ranged attacks against units containing Characters gain +1 to hit rolls.
- Ravenwing: The unit gains +1"  Movement and may re-roll Advance rolls.
- Stormwing: The unit's ranged attacks with Bolt weapons re-roll to hit rolls of 1.

traits.name: Swift Action
traits.desc: The unit may fire weapons with an Advance or Charge order, it may fire them without a to hit penalty.

traits.name: Unleashed Hunters
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 to melee hit rolls until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: Bolter Drill
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Deflagrate(5+)" ability with Bolt weapons. Legion Tactical Squads gain "Deflagrate(4+)" with Bolt weapons.

traits.name: Unshakable Defence
traits.desc: The unit gains +1 Leadership and cannot be Pinned while it is in cover.

traits.name: Encarmine Fury
traits.desc: If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 Strength until the end of the current battle round. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: Without Remorse, Without Relent
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Frenzy(1")" ability. Only for creature models and Walkers.

traits.name: The Medusa's Scales
traits.desc: The unit reduces the strength of all shooting attacks against it by -1. Only for creature models.

traits.name: Inviolate Armor
traits.desc: The unit may reroll one armor save per battle round. Only for creature models. Additionally, vehicles repair either one Engine Damage or Weapon Damage on themselves during each Rally phase.

traits.name: Interlocking Tactics
traits.desc: Whenever the unit makes a shooting attack against a target which has already been successfully hit in the same Shooting phase by another Ultramarines unit, it may re-roll To Wound and Armor Penetration rolls of 1.

traits.name: Certainty and Resolve
traits.desc: The unit is immune to the effects of the "Terrifying" ability, and a pinned or fleeing unit automatically regroups at the start of the turn or when it reaches the edge of the board.

traits.name: Promethean Blood
traits.desc: The unit reduces the strength of all Flamer, Melta, Plasma and Volkite ranged attacks against it by -1. Additionally, vehicles repair either one Engine Damage or Weapon Damage on themselves during each Rally phase.

traits.name: Strength of Will
traits.desc: The unit ignores negative leadership modifiers. Only for creature units.

traits.name: By Wing and Talon
traits.desc: Infantry units which do not have the "Unyielding" ability gain the "Infiltrator" ability, while Jump Pack Infantry, Bike, Jet Bike and Walker units gain the "Furious Charge" ability.

traits.name: Shadow and Fury
traits.desc: The unit gains the "Deflect" ability against ranged attacks from enemy units which are more than 12" away.

special_traits.name: Blackshields
special_traits.desc: Two traits chosen in combination from the Space Marines and Chaos Space Marines codexes may be chosen and taken by all units in the army.
